# IRoundsVaultBaseEnums
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/rounds-vault/IRoundsVaultBaseEnums.sol)


## Enums
### BaseVaultType
Flavor of a `RoundsVaultBase` instance. Determines the deposit and exchange assets.


```solidity
enum BaseVaultType {
    Input, /// Deposit asset is the target vault's underlying; exchange asset is the target vault's shares.
    Output /// Deposit asset is the target vault's shares; exchange asset is the target vault's underlying.
}
```

### RoundState
Progression of states for an individual round.

`NotOpened` is the EVM default for any id never written to; the constructor writes
`Opened` to round 0 so the first round is usable at deployment time.


```solidity
enum RoundState {
    NotOpened, /// The round has not been opened yet. Default zero value for unused round ids.
    Opened, /// The round is open: it accepts deposits and current-round receipt redemptions.
    InSettlement, /// The round is closed; its supply is frozen and awaiting settlement.
    Settled /// The settlement trade has executed; receipts for this round are now exchangeable for the exchange
    /// asset at the snapshotted rate.
}
```
